SELECT DISTINCT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient p 
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID 
WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND e.Symptoms IS NULL AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SC170: negative%'
